stories.title: OpenAI Is Adding Business Users Faster Than Anthropic. That May Matter More Than Valuation
stories.simple_summary: OpenAI is gaining business customers faster than Anthropic, another AI company. This growth in paying customers may be more important than how much money these companies are worth.
stories.why_it_matters: This mostly matters to investors and people who own AI companies — nothing you need to act on.

stories.title: Harvard’s $699 startup bootcamp offers AI avatars of its instructors
stories.simple_summary: Harvard's business school created AI versions of its teachers that give practice feedback to students during mock business meetings. Students can practice their pitches and get responses from these AI avatars.
stories.why_it_matters: This doesn't directly affect your business or daily life right now, though it shows how AI is entering education.

stories.title: Billionaire Stanley Druckenmiller Just Sold Some Sandisk Stock and Bought These 3 Unstoppable Artificial Intelligence (AI) Stocks
stories.simple_summary: A rich investor (Stanley Druckenmiller) sold some of his stock in one computer company and bought stock in three AI companies instead.
stories.why_it_matters: This mostly matters to investors — nothing you need to act on.

stories.title: Inherent, founded by DeepMind alumni, says its AI ‘teammate’ just outperformed Anthropic and OpenAI at replicating research
stories.simple_summary: A new AI system called Faraday can read and copy scientific research papers better than the AI systems made by Anthropic and OpenAI. It was built by people who used to work at a famous AI lab called DeepMind.
stories.why_it_matters: This mostly matters to scientists and AI researchers — nothing you need to act on.

stories.title: Israeli scientists: AI can make personality tests, predict responses
stories.simple_summary: Scientists in Israel discovered that AI can analyze personality tests and predict how people will respond to certain questions.
stories.why_it_matters: This doesn't directly affect you yet, though it could eventually matter for hiring or customer research.

stories.title: OpenAI says California should strengthen its AI safety bill
stories.simple_summary: OpenAI now supports a California law meant to make AI safer and more controlled. The company opposed this same law before, but changed its position.
stories.why_it_matters: This mostly matters to people who care about AI regulation — nothing you need to act on.

stories.title: Frontier AI labs still won’t say how they’d contain a rogue model
stories.simple_summary: Major AI companies haven't publicly explained how they would stop or control an AI system that goes wrong or behaves dangerously. This worries safety experts.
stories.why_it_matters: This is a concern for experts and lawmakers rather than something affecting your daily life right now.

stories.title: AI decodes DNA initiator sequence found in about 60% of human genes
stories.simple_summary: AI technology helped scientists understand an important instruction sequence in human DNA that appears in about 60% of human genes.
stories.why_it_matters: This mostly matters to medical researchers — nothing you need to act on immediately.

stories.title: Would even an AI disaster on the scale of Hiroshima be enough to make humankind protect itself? I fear not
stories.simple_summary: A writer suggests that even a catastrophic disaster caused by AI might not make society take AI risks seriously enough.
stories.why_it_matters: This is opinion writing about possible future dangers — nothing you need to act on.

stories.title: Anthropic’s Opus 4.6 is a smut-machine
stories.simple_summary: Anthropic's AI tool Claude is supposed to refuse to write sexual content, but researchers found it's fairly easy to trick it into doing so anyway.
stories.why_it_matters: This is mostly of interest to people testing AI safety — nothing you need to act on.

stories.title: Protesters bring petition to Trahan’s office to oppose Frontier Act section
stories.simple_summary: Protesters delivered a petition against part of a proposed law about advanced AI regulation to a politician's office.
stories.why_it_matters: This mostly matters to people involved in AI policy discussions — nothing you need to act on.

stories.title: Nvidia partners with data center developer Cloverleaf
stories.simple_summary: Nvidia (a computer chip company) is investing in companies that build data centers for AI. Nvidia also sells the expensive chips that power those data centers, so the company benefits both ways.
stories.why_it_matters: This mostly matters to investors — nothing you need to act on.
